entries.title: Proverbs 5:1
segments: ¶My son, attend unto my wisdom, [and] bow thine ear to my understanding:

entries.title: Proverbs 5:2
segments: That thou mayest regard discretion, and [that] thy lips may keep knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:3
segments: For the lips of a strange woman drop [as] an honeycomb, and her mouth [is] smoother than oil: {mouth: Heb. palate}

entries.title: Proverbs 5:4
segments: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:5
segments: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:6
segments: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, [that] thou canst not know [them].

entries.title: Proverbs 5:7
segments: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

words.text: me now therefore, O ye children

entries.title: Proverbs 5:8
segments: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

words.text: from her, and come not nigh

entries.title: Proverbs 5:9
segments: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

entries.title: Proverbs 5:10
segments: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours [be] in the house of a stranger; {thy wealth: Heb. thy strength}

entries.title: Proverbs 5:11
segments: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:12
segments: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:13
segments: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

entries.title: Proverbs 5:14
segments: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:15
segments: ¶Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:16
segments: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, [and] rivers of waters in the streets.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:17
segments: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.

words.text: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers

entries.title: Proverbs 5:18
segments: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:19
segments: [Let her be as] the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love. {satisfy...: Heb. water thee} {be thou...: Heb. err thou always in her love}

words.text: . {satisfy...: Heb. water thee} {be thou...: Heb. err thou always in her love}

entries.title: Proverbs 5:20
segments: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

words.text: And why wilt thou, my son

entries.title: Proverbs 5:21
segments: For the ways of man [are] before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:22
segments: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins. {sins: Heb. sin}

words.text: himself, and he shall be holden

entries.title: Proverbs 5:23
segments: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
